verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk 'export all my data' feature in open formats, and nothing about account offboarding. What it does show is read APIs, such as the transactions API for viewing transactions, accounts, and statements. It also shows a Zapier recipe that exports card transactions to CSV. Both are developer building blocks or third-party workarounds that approximate export rather than a product capability for full data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
